lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Whoa... Are we finally out of the underground? Look at those massive spires.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: Behold the Citadel of Eclipse. Once a throne of legends, now a stronghold shrouded in blood and thunder.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: The atmosphere here is suffocating. It feels like lightning could strike from the ceiling at any second.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: The master of this castle wields a ruthless power. Traps, heavy armor, and lethal blades guard every corridor.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: I didn't come this far just to turn back now. Let's breach the main hall!
